findings: All thirteen native blocks and twenty-two input terminals independently compared to individual crops, full source and full preview.

HLT KU551AW4 branches to AB D05, AC D08/G12 loop and AD D05. Source MA293BR4 scan feeds AD D09 only. D RD151AB4 branches to AE D12 and AM D12; IC CH151HU4 to AF D13/AN D13, SUM AP551BH4 to AG G08/AP G08. Native controls MC062AX4/MC062AZ4/MC063AS4 and five AH input rows traced.

AH D04 negation fanout to AU/AL; duplicate AJ J02 starred outputs and AL B02 starred output, WQ001/MA257 references, four connector lines and interchangeability note preserved. AB 706506/A-A4E4 source differs from listing and is retained explicitly. Native LOG153B footer and 000 MA151 header checked.
